links.comparator_used: Alternative persona: prompt framed as a radiologist vs as a cardiologist (no no-role baseline tested)
links.outcome: Agreement with human reference standard for CAD-RADS scoring (weighted Cohen's kappa) and management recommendations
links.effect: Claude-3.7 κ = 0.997 regardless of identity; Gemini radiologist κ = 0.962 vs cardiologist κ = 0.990; ChatGPT radiologist κ = 0.896 vs cardiologist κ = 0.715; DeepSeek radiologist κ = 0.637 vs cardiologist κ = 0.768. Scoring and management recommendations varied with prompt identity.
links.tradeoff: Results were inconsistent across models, and the best persona differed by model. Management recommendations were much less accurate than scoring regardless of persona.
links.quote: Furthermore, both CAD-RADS scoring and management recommendations varied depending on the professional identity specified in the prompt.

design_hint: prompt persona framing (specialist role in prompt)
